name: YMM Product Filter for Woo – Year Make Model search
author: TyresAddict

sections.description:
Boost your automotive shop with YMM Finder widget and product filter.
Searching by Make Model Year (or another order: Year Make Model) / Vehicle.
For spare parts shops, aftermarket, tuning stores etc. Even for non-auto applications.

Features

  • Filter’s Sidebar widget for catalog, category and shop pages of WooCommerce
  • Make – Model – Year Filtration
  • Year – Make – Model Filtration
  • YMM and MMY Finders – widgets for any pages. Like external UI for Filter, redirects to category
  • Theme for Finder
  • Fitments product tab
  • Import / Export YMM data

PRO Features

  • More themes for Finder and FIlter
  • Integration with Tyre Finder
  • Garage feature
  • Metrics feature
  • YMM sync with Categories

Required Plugin

  • WooCommerce

Documentation

Plugin documentation is available here.
